title: 6.1 Introduction to Trusses
description: Understand why trusses are material-efficient, apply the two-force-member model, and use the method of joints to classify tension and compression.

learning_objectives.statement: Define a simple truss and identify its basic elements
State the assumptions used in truss analysis
Apply the Method of Joints to determine forces in truss members

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
